visualCharacteristics.purpose: Embedded third-party content (e.g. store-locator map) with an optional side panel holding a heading, eyebrow text and a postcode search

contentPattern.structure: one row; content cell (heading, text, optional search link whose URL ends in an empty query parameter, e.g. /locations?postcode=, link title = input placeholder) and an embed cell containing only the embed URL (map, YouTube, Vimeo, Twitter/X or any iframe-able URL; optional picture = click-to-load placeholder)
